title: AI Enables Intelligent Manufacturing of the Automobile Industry
summary: Huawei reports that its Pangu AI models made GAC's research and development work 30 percent more efficient; the joint submission presents other manufacturing gains as potential.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: GAC and Huawei are researching AI for design, inspection, maintenance and scheduling, and GAC's architecture for these uses is in place. The submission presents its time and capacity figures as potential improvements: production capacity up by 10 percent and production scheduling time shortened by 60 percent. In a 2025 customer story, Huawei reports that its Pangu models made GAC's research and development work 30 percent more efficient. No independent source confirms this figure.
purpose: Improve automobile design, manufacturing, maintenance, and scheduling.

ratings.reason: Huawei reports that its Pangu models made GAC's research and development work 30 percent more efficient, which is time saved; the figure comes from the developer alone.
Employees are intended to face fewer hazardous and repetitive tasks; no source reports a change for any worker.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: AI Enables Intelligent Manufacturing of the Automobile Industry
evidence.quote: The production capacity will be improved by 10% and the production scheduling time will be shortened by 60%.

evidence.citation: Huawei Enterprise, GAC: Revolutionizing Automotive Manufacturing with Intelligence, customer story, 2025. Huawei supplies the platforms and the Pangu models, so the source is the developer's own account; it reports a realized 30 percent efficiency gain in GAC's R&D but gives no method or baseline.
evidence.title: GAC: Revolutionizing Automotive Manufacturing with Intelligence
evidence.quote: For example, Huawei's Pangu AI models revolutionized GAC's R&D processes, boosting GAC's operational efficiency across multiple scenarios by 30%.

evidence.citation: 脑极体 (Naojiti), 广汽：让汽车制造飞跃智能时代, Sina Finance, 25 May 2025. Huawei later ran this text as its own story on GAC, in which Huawei says that its Pangu models made GAC's research and development 30 percent more efficient.
